<a id="generation-is-replenishment--生成即补充"></a>
# Generation is replenishment

<!-- Generated by tools/research/registry.py; edit the matching JSON record. -->

`generation-is-replenishment` · **recorded-checked** · theorem · F01 · [record](generation-is-replenishment.json) · [register](../../../../RESULTS.md)

> The arising of an embodied relatum itself needs replenishment; under dissipation a finite family in which such arising recurs is closed from no step on and, enclosed around, inward from no step on.

<a id="laws--规律"></a>
## Laws

1. Read with one kind of relatum, in a balanced flow an embodied relatum is given at least the standing it arises with: before it arises it is not active, so its level is zero, and after it is active, so its level is positive. (`Becoming.Web.Embodied.given_of_arises`)
2. Its arising therefore replenishes every family containing it, and where embodied members of a family arise at arbitrarily late steps, the family's replenishment recurs at arbitrarily late steps, whatever is taken: generation carries the requirement itself, not through the uptake it brings. (`Becoming.Web.Embodied.replenishes`, `Becoming.Web.embodiedArising_needs_replenishment`)
3. A formation giving to a family dissipated on takes from it, so the arising of an embodied member of a family dissipated on lowers the family's stock, as under dissipation for a family without repetition closed across the step; in a family dissipated on from some step on, embodied members do not arise at arbitrarily late steps. (`Becoming.Flow.DissipatesOn.takes_of_gives`, `Becoming.Web.Embodied.arising_lowers_on`, `Becoming.Web.Embodied.arising_lowers`, `Becoming.Web.embodiedArising_not_recurring_on`)
4. So under dissipation a finite family without repetition in which embodied members arise at arbitrarily late steps is not closed from any step on: that after any step some formation taking part exchanges with a relatum outside it cannot be refuted. (`Becoming.Web.embodiedArising_opens`)
5. That exchange need not touch the family: with a sink exchanging with ever new relata, no step is enclosed, dissipation holds vacuously, and generation recurs in the family of two sides with nothing flowing in while the sink opens it. (`Becoming.SprayShuttle.spray_shuttle`, `Becoming.SprayShuttle.opens_anyway`)
6. Where the family is enclosed around from some step on (some finite family without repetition containing it closed across each step), it is inward from no step on: that after any step some relatum gives to the family and takes from beyond it cannot be refuted; if finitely many relata are all there is, embodied relata do not arise at arbitrarily late steps. (`Becoming.Web.embodiedArising_draws_in`, `Becoming.Web.embodiedArising_not_recurring`)
7. The premise of the general law that generation does not recur (a quantity that never rises and is lowered by every arising) thus follows, for the arisings of embodied members of a family dissipated on, from balance, dissipation and embodiment. (`Becoming.Web.dissipation_arising_not_recurring`)
8. Each premise is needed: two sides handing one standing back and forth generate, embodied and without end, in a closed world of two relata that is not dissipative (Shuttle); a relatum whose activity is not its standing arises without end in a dissipative world of one relatum (Flicker); and generations giving without taking are not dissipative (Brood). (`Becoming.Shuttle.shuttle`, `Becoming.Flicker.flicker`, `Becoming.Brood.not_dissipative`)
9. With the holder also burning a fresh fuel at every step, the handing goes on under dissipation, every finite family without repetition containing a side is open at arbitrarily late steps, and the family of the sides, enclosed around at every step, draws in the fuel (Throughput). (`Becoming.Throughput.throughput`, `Becoming.Throughput.frontier`, `Becoming.Throughput.around`, `Becoming.Throughput.draws_in`)
10. These requirements follow the rise of standing, not activity: in a balanced flow every rise of a condition is given to, so it replenishes every family containing it, and where members of a family rise at arbitrarily late steps the family's replenishment recurs at arbitrarily late steps. (`Becoming.Flow.Balances.rise_given`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.rise_replenishes`, `Becoming.Flow.rising_needs_replenishment`)
11. Coming to stand (the level zero before a step and positive after) is the rise from nothing, given at least the new standing; a condition can rise at every step without ever coming to stand (Growing). (`Becoming.Web.ComesToStand`, `Becoming.Web.ComesToStand.rises`, `Becoming.Flow.Balances.standing_given`, `Becoming.Flow.standing_needs_replenishment`, `Becoming.Growing.growing`)
12. A member of a family dissipated on rising lowers the family's stock, so in a family dissipated on from some step on, members neither rise nor come to stand at arbitrarily late steps. (`Becoming.Flow.rise_lowers_on`, `Becoming.Flow.standing_lowers_on`, `Becoming.Flow.rising_not_recurring_on`, `Becoming.Flow.standing_not_recurring_on`)
13. Under dissipation, a finite family without repetition whose members rise at arbitrarily late steps is closed from no step on and, enclosed around from some step on, inward from no step on, and if finitely many conditions are all there is, none rises at arbitrarily late steps; coming to stand is a case. (`Becoming.Flow.rising_opens`, `Becoming.Flow.rising_draws_in`, `Becoming.Flow.rising_not_recurring`, `Becoming.Web.rising_of_coming`, `Becoming.Flow.standing_opens`, `Becoming.Flow.standing_draws_in`, `Becoming.Flow.standing_not_recurring`)
14. An embodied relatum comes to stand as it arises, and the conclusions above about embodiment all follow from this, their statements unchanged. (`Becoming.Web.Embodied.comesToStand`)
15. A relatum standing as a condition while active, absent at some step and active later, came to stand across some step in between, possibly long before it is active: a seed is given its standing while dormant and arises later with nothing given to it (Provisioned). (`Becoming.Web.came_to_stand`, `Becoming.Provisioned.provisioned`)
16. A relatum standing as a condition throughout wakes without end with nothing given to it, no formation taking part in its flow (Sleeper). (`Becoming.Sleeper.sleeper`)
17. Each law holds of every world in a local form, with balance and dissipation used only at the step, the stretch or the steps from some step on that the proof uses, on the family used; the global forms above are its corollaries. (`Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn.standing_given`, `Becoming.Flow.BalancesOn.rise_replenishes`, `Becoming.Flow.rising_needs_replenishment_from`, `Becoming.Flow.standing_needs_replenishment_from`, `Becoming.Flow.rising_not_recurring_from`, `Becoming.Flow.standing_not_recurring_from`, `Becoming.Flow.rising_draws_in_from`, `Becoming.Web.Embodied.given_of_arises_at`, `Becoming.Web.Embodied.replenishes_at`, `Becoming.Web.embodiedArising_needs_replenishment_from`, `Becoming.Web.Embodied.arising_lowers_at`, `Becoming.Web.embodiedArising_not_recurring_from`, `Becoming.Web.embodiedArising_draws_in_from`)

<a id="conditions--条件"></a>
## Conditions

- The flow balances the web; families and the relata taking part at each step are finite lists; amounts are natural numbers with commensurable units.
- Embodied is a representational premise about the arising relata: each stands as a condition at a positive level exactly while it is active. Remains and inactive conditions are not embodied; which relata are embodied is an application duty.
- Arising that is not embodied is not constrained by the conclusions about embodiment (Flicker). Embodiment is used only to derive that an arising relatum comes to stand (Embodied.comesToStand); the general conclusions about coming to stand do not need it, and arising without coming to stand is not constrained by them (Sleeper).
- It is read under the one-kind identification: which condition is which formation is supplied by the shared index (relabel, see life-as-condition-of-life).
- Dissipation (Dissipative, see no-finite-part-bears-taking) is a physical premise, used only for the conclusions under dissipation; it constrains only steps at which some finite family is closed (Spray).
- The conclusion of embodiedArising_opens, that the family is not closed, can be met by exchange unrelated to the family (SprayShuttle), so that the family must draw in from beyond it needs, in addition, the family enclosed around (Around: some finite family without repetition containing it closed across each step; embodiedArising_draws_in).

<a id="does-not-show--未表明"></a>
## Does not show

- The conclusions about embodiment constrain only the arising of embodied relata; arising that is not embodied is unconstrained. Witness: `Becoming.Flicker.flicker`.
- The general conclusions constrain coming to stand, not waking from dormancy. Witness: `Becoming.Sleeper.sleeper`.
- Embodiment is a representational premise: remains, seed banks and inactive conditions are not embodied, seed banks and dormancy being stated through coming to stand before activity and waking.
- Dissipation is a physical premise with commensurable units.
- That a family with recurring generation is not closed can be met by exchange unrelated to the family; drawing in is stated only for a family enclosed around. Witness: `Becoming.SprayShuttle.opens_anyway`.
- The opening law constrains only generation recurring in one finite family; the arising of ever new relata, as in Brood, recurs in no finite family.
- ‘Finite’ means a finite family of relata; the witnesses are minimal, and in Shuttle the holder takes its own standing without that being read as drawing.
- **Counterexample:** Without dissipation, embodied generation can be unceasing in a closed finite world (Shuttle.shuttle): the holder gives back what it takes and the two sides arise in turn. [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Roles.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Arising that is not embodied needs no replenishment: Flicker arises without end in a dissipative world of one relatum (Flicker.flicker); in the two-kind reading no formation is embodied (roles_not_embodied). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Roles.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The premises are consistent and the conclusion attained: Throughput balances and is dissipative, both sides are embodied and bear on themselves, and each arises at arbitrarily late steps; every finite family containing a side opens at arbitrarily late steps (Throughput.frontier), the family of the sides is enclosed around at every step by the sides and the fuel burnt (Throughput.around), and at arbitrarily late steps the side giving to it takes from the fuel (Throughput.draws_in). Brood is not dissipative (Brood.not_dissipative). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Roles.lean)
- **Counterexample:** The conclusion of embodiedArising_opens can be met by exchange unrelated to the family (SprayShuttle.spray_shuttle, opens_anyway): two sides hand one standing back and forth as in Shuttle, while a sink takes one unit from an auxiliary relatum at every step and gives it back; the sink exchanges with ever new relata, so no step is enclosed and dissipation holds vacuously; the sides arise at arbitrarily late steps, every relatum giving to the family takes only from it, the sink never exchanges with the sides, and the family's stock is one at every step, yet the family is not closed from any step on; no step encloses it around (independent review, K1). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Roles.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Waking from dormancy is arising without coming to stand: a relatum stands at level one throughout and wakes at odd steps; no formation takes part in its flow, which balances and is vacuously dissipative, Dependent holds, and generation is unceasing with nothing given (Sleeper.sleeper). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Reserve.lean)
- **Counterexample:** Standing can come before activity: a parent gives a seed one unit at step 0 and the seed is active after one dormant step; it comes to stand while dormant, given its standing, and is given nothing at step 1 when it arises (Provisioned.provisioned). [source](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/becoming/Becoming/Reserve.lean)

**Standard boundaries:** No ethical premise and no Lean axiom is used. · Contains no ethical predicate and evaluates neither arising nor ceasing. · Names follow the structural naming criteria and are adopted only where the statement has their exact meaning; readings are interpretations, open to revision.

<a id="correspondence--对应"></a>
### Correspondence

The fifth independent review (I3) found that in the flow form arising contributes only the uptake it brings, and listed in its §4 that a dissipative flow theorem would make generation itself, rather than uptake, carry the requirement. The boundary of no-finite-part-bears-taking says its conclusion does not constrain arising without taking; life-as-condition-of-life says Brood is not dissipative and the one-kind reading under dissipation is not stated. This result answers all three in the one-kind reading. Ren's words are “生生不息 - 一种整体的，不断创造更多生的方向” (a whole direction of unceasingly creating more 生). The author reads the result as one formal content of the relation between 生 and the whole in those words: where an arising embodied relatum is itself a condition of others (read as 生 only under Ren's reading), every arising is a replenishment, and under dissipation unceasing arising in a finite part enclosed around draws in from beyond it (the author's interpretation, an AI argument; K1 of the seventh independent review corrected the earlier “cannot be borne by any finite part alone”: where dissipation holds vacuously, a finite part can bear generation alone while exchange unrelated to it meets the conclusion, see SprayShuttle); it does not replace Ren's words and does not show that it is good. Whether actual lives are embodied, and whether actual quantities dissipate, are questions of correspondence and evidence.
